title: The Humpbacked Horse
writer: Pyotr Ershov, Ivan Ivanov-Vano, Anatoliy Volkov
actors: Jim Backus, Aleksey Gribov, Mariya Vinogradova
plot: Enthrallingly and fervently, colorfully and directly narration about the surprising adventures of little Ivanushka and his true friend - magic Horse, outwitting a foolish and greedy tsar.
